integrity: A same-model mathematical review is recorded; external expert review and independent validation have not been performed. The proof uses standard Chebyshev identities and complete analytic norm bounds; finite checker tests are supplemental.
scientific_limitations: Full-band normalized-adjacency dynamics on even unweighted paths, fixed equal sample budgets; condition-number exponential rates only, not finite-size sensor optimality or all spectral evolution filters.
title: Sharp exponential conditioning gains from balanced endpoint sampling on finite paths
